name: Fatal Charms
caption: A cross-federation stable spanning the WWFL and ICWL, its two attested members each entering AOWF's own Day 2 Television Championship unification match as their home fed's own reigning champion.
notes: Billed explicitly on Day 2: Blade "is a member of the Fatal Charms"; The Charm is "another member of the Fatal Charms." Nightshade is helped to his feet at the Day 4 finale by Blade (among others), but no served text calls him a Fatal Charms member outright — not asserted here.

tenures.note: Spans the WWFL and ICWL; both attested members entered the Day 2 AOWF Television Championship unification match as their own home fed's reigning champion.
